fb_text:
Every software pitch sounds the same until you touch the thing.

So here's the whole demo, no signup, no install, no card. It takes about a minute.

Open the demo page. It looks like a text thread, because that's the product — your crew texts, the office paperwork writes itself.

First tap: log a visit note the way your guy actually sends one from the truck. Watch it become a clean service log.

Second tap: ask it the gate code for a client. It answers from the records. That's the call your office stops getting.

Third tap: see the recap it drafts for the customer. Timestamped proof of the visit, ready to send, before anyone asks "were you even here?"

Three taps and you just ran a whole visit from a text message. If it doesn't click in a minute, close the tab and you're out nothing.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
